records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Landscape Architecture and concurrent enrollment in LND ARCH 262.

records.title: Landscape Architectural Design II

records.title: Landscape Architectural Construction III
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: LND ARCH 366 with a C or better.
